features.name: Hollow Tree

estimates.shell_method: Seven coarse vertical sectors fit to radial source bands; gaps and correspondence to exact wood segments are estimates
estimates.base_flare: Lower unsupported section extrapolates nearest measured shell band by at most 8 percent per 3 m

features.limits: Recognizable hollow dead-cedar shell, no foliage. East/southeast entrance remains open. Wall thickness, individual cracks, braces, bark and exact cavity are unfinished. The 2011 conservation photos confirm the open shell and top flashing; City 2022 returns set present size. No independent accuracy or runtime acceptance.
features.model_stage: M1 source-driven massing; Blender/runtime review pending

features.name: Siwash Rock lookout / former No. 6 searchlight shelter

estimates.body: Rear and side wall envelope to nearby ground returns; curved seaward window dimensions not measured

features.limits: Concrete deck form and height are source-backed. Rail details, window/sill height, wall base and approach transition are blockout estimates. Upper public approach needs terrain/contact review; do not mark this asset walkable from a successful import.
features.model_stage: M1 source-driven massing; Blender/runtime review pending

features.name: Third Beach concession and washroom building

plane_review.limits: M1 large roof planes only. HVAC, skylights, parapets and small roof breaks are suppressed. Plane fit uses the same source and is not an independent accuracy check.
plane_review.spatial_label_vote: 13 neighbours, two passes; no height blending

estimates.walls: Roof-edge extrusion to City DTM; facade footprint, doors and eaves not measured

features.limits: The distinct angled facility roof is individually identified. Forecourt, stairs, parking, beach access and exact facades remain unfinished; this building alone does not complete the Third Beach public-space group.
features.model_stage: M1 source-driven massing; Blender/runtime review pending
